inv.desc_es:
ALQUILER DE LOCAL DE RESTAURACIÓN CON INSTALACIÓN DE GAS IDEAL PARA ARROCERÍAS
Se alquila Local de restauración en el Mercado Barcelo, con instalación de gas ciudad ideal para arrocerías u otros establecimientos de restauración. Equipado con campana, fregadero, barra e instalación de agua, luz y gas, y licencia en vigor. Se encuentra en la zona de restauración en la segunda planta del Mercado Barceló con horario de apertura de lunes a domingo de 9.00 a 24:00. Ideal para venta directa y delivery.
inv.desc_en:
PROPERTY FOR RENTABILITY – INVESTMENT WITH 14% ANNUAL NET PROFITABILITY
Sale/transfer of commercial premises in the Barceló Market currently rented, ideal for investors seeking high profitability from day one.
- Sale price: €70,000
- Monthly rent paid by tenant: €1,500
- Annual net profitability: 14%
- Tenant in operation
- Recurring and stable income
- Low initial investment and excellent return

The premises are located in the restaurant area of the Barceló Market in Madrid and have a current lease agreement, offering an attractive opportunity to generate immediate income without the need for additional management.

Due to its price and profitability level, it is an unusual opportunity in the market, especially for small and medium-sized investors who want to diversify into real estate with an already operating asset.

Ideal for both individual investors and wealth managers looking to maximize returns.

For more information, contact privately.
